column1: # Indiana Jones 4 (indy4kor korean.trs), U preset: 2 bpp, I4KO.MAP's default (true-colour) preset.
# Fields: output 8.3 name, SCUMM charset, TTF, size, bpp, ascent.
# Verbs and sentence line (charset 1) and dialogue (charset 2): NanumGothic-Bold.
# Size and ascent are what mkfont.py --fit-cell picks for the charset's cell over the
# korean.trs text (no glyph leaves the cell): Nanum 16x16 -> 15/14, 20x18 -> 16/15;
# The credit face takes a limit of its own (seventh field): the bundle's map and puzzle tables
# (records 20 and 83, never drawn) decode to a few KS X 1001 symbols, two of which (U+0421 С,
# U+30B3 コ) GowunBatang lacks; the text itself uses Hangul, one jamo (ㅊ) and ASCII only.
# Charsets 4 and 5 have no korean0N.fnt; I4KO.MAP points them at I4U2.SVF and I4U1.SVF.
# The TTF field starts with $FONTS (default ~/scummvm-i18n/fonts; set FONTS=... to move it).
